# xVS Creations

> xVS Creations is a global creative and branding design agency founded in 2014. We help startups, brands, and other agencies with branding, UI/UX, graphic design, web & app development, motion graphics, and 3D design. Headquartered in Lucknow, India, with a US presence in Sheridan, Wyoming. White-label creative execution for agencies is available.

## Services
- [Branding & Brand Identity](https://xvscreations.com/services): Logo design, visual identity systems, brand guidelines, and campaign rollouts.
- [UI/UX Design](https://xvscreations.com/services): User flows, wireframing, and interface design for web and mobile products.
- [Graphic Design](https://xvscreations.com/services): Print and digital design across outdoor media and online platforms.
- [Web Design & Development](https://xvscreations.com/services): Responsive, mobile-first marketing websites and CMS builds.
- [Motion Graphics & Video Editing](https://xvscreations.com/services): Explainers, product launch videos, logo animation, and social content.
- [3D Product Design & Animation](https://xvscreations.com/services): Product renders and 3D visuals for marketing and launches.

## For agencies (white-label)
- [White-label creative partner](https://xvscreations.com/agency): Brand-neutral, NDA-ready execution for marketing agencies, media houses, and growing brands. Typical project range USD 5,000-10,000 or monthly retainers.
